Question: The weight of \(\tfrac13\) of a large pizza together with \(3\tfrac12\) cups of orange slices is the same as the weight of \(\tfrac34\) of a large pizza together with \(\tfrac12\) cup of orange slices. A cup of orange slices weighs \(\tfrac14\) of a pound. What is the weight, in pounds, of a large pizza?
